situation: He lands the first hit of the match
line: Slow.
You were quicker than I recall. You will not be again.
Fourth. Behind the goons. You rank lower with every breath.
Adequate. That is all you were, and it was generous.
Run. It changes nothing.
A lucky step. You will not repeat it.
Remember that.

situation: The opponent blocks a light hit
line: Predictable.

situation: A long, even stretch of the fight
line: This could have ended ages ago. It ends when I say.
Bow. It is the only thing you will do right today.
You were winded ages ago.
That was clever. It was also late.

situation: The opponent has been turtling for a minute
line: Hiding behind your arms. You were braver last time.
Guard, guard, guard. Fifth. Behind the goons.

situation: The opponent is rushing him non-stop
line: Loud. Fast. Pointless.
Running again. Fifth. Behind the goons.
Charge all you like. I will wait.

situation: The opponent has fired three beams
line: One beam. Then another. You had nothing else.
Hold still. This takes a moment.
Is this the whole show?
Flattery. It will not save you.

situation: The opponent is on the brink
line: You were at the edge. I was never.

situation: A hit lands on the opponent's head
line: Your face was the last thing I wanted to see. It is broken.
Your {part}. It was your best feature. It is broken.

situation: The opponent is slow after a break
line: You were fast because of that {part}. You are not now.
Noted. Move on.
Again. Without effort.

situation: He said (Protagonist): 'Good. You came. I was worried you'd stay home and sulk.'
line: You were always worried. It was your best quality. Begin.

situation: He said (Protagonist): 'You're doing the face again.'
line: I do not make faces.
You were winded ages ago.

situation: He said (Protagonist): 'Remember when we used to do this for fun?'
line: You did it for fun. I was working.

situation: He said (Protagonist): 'Did you practise the scowl?'
line: I was born with it.
It was a gift.

situation: She said (Empress): 'Do take that cape off. Ours is longer.'
line: You were vulgar. You are still vulgar. Filth.

situation: He said (Cyborg): 'May I offer you the menu?'
line: You were a machine that ate. You will be a machine that stopped.

situation: She said (Empress): 'Revision Four. We have added a hat.'
line: Filth.
You will not.

situation: He said (Protagonist): 'I'll help fix it once I'm done with you.'
line: You said that about the bridge. It is still down.
Ignore me. It will make no difference.

situation: The opponent keeps promising to fix things
line: You said that before the tower fell. It is still down.
Rude was the second time you fixed nothing.
You have said that four times. It was never the last.

situation: The opponent boasts about a number
line: The number does not matter. You were always behind the goons.
Say that again. I would like the witnesses to hear.
I have heard better from things that cannot speak.
Laugh. It is the last sound you make well.
You were funny once. Try again in the dark.

situation: The opponent says: 'Is that all you've got?'
line: No. It is all you will see.

situation: The opponent calls him a sulker
line: I am not sulking. I am deciding how long you last.

situation: A taunt, adjusts a cuff without looking, 1 second
line: You were adequate.

situation: A taunt, adjusts a cuff, 1 second
line: Fifth. Behind the goons.

situation: A taunt, adjusts a cuff, 1 second
line: Is that what you call a fight?

situation: A taunt, adjusts a cuff, 1 second
line: Look at me. I have not moved.

situation: A taunt, adjusts a cuff, 1 second (vs Empress)
line: Do try to look worried. It would be a start.

situation: A taunt, adjusts a cuff, 1 second (vs Cyborg)
line: I was not on your menu. I wrote it.

situation: Quiet stretch, the opponent holding back
line: He is holding back. He always holds back.

situation: The opponent promised to fix something and means it
line: He means it. That is what makes it unbearable.
Why does he never tire?
I should end this. I do not.
He is better than me.
I can't. I can't feel my arms.
I do need him.
He will not break. I must make him.
Not yet. Let him spend himself.
This is not caution. It is patience.
Press. Allow him no air.
Retreat is a shape of patience.
Slowly. Deliberately.
I am not running. I am repositioning.
Every second he glows I could end this. I do not.
Good. The rest was noise.
Why does he look at me like that? Like I am a friend.

situation: He just won a long exchange
line: I felt nothing. Good.

situation: He is hit on the head
line: You touched my face. You were alive a moment ago.

situation: He is hit hard on the arm
line: My {part}. You will regret it. You will regret being adequate.
Remember that. It is the last time.
My {part}. Noted.

situation: He is on the brink, facade cracking
line: I can't feel my {part}. Help me.

situation: He is on the brink, facade cracking
line: Don't. Don't look at me like that.

situation: He is on the brink, the Cyborg offers a refund
line: I can't... I don't want a refund. I want you gone.
I'm still here. I'm still here.
...Noted.
That was a mistake. Mine.

situation: He stands up after a knockdown
line: I did not fall. I chose the floor.

situation: The opponent offers help at the brink
line: Don't. ...I don't need you.
That is the only one you get.

situation: His rank-gag is thrown back at him
line: Do not say that. Do not say that to me.
Nobody will remember that {thing}. Or you.
{place} was fine. It was never mine.
The crowd was decoration. Decoration falls.
Nobody asked them to stand there.

situation: A bridge falls after a promise
line: You broke the {thing}. Then you promised. You were always both.
Run, then. You were never the point.
They flee. They were always going to flee.
Do not hurry them. They will only fall over.
Noted. The audience is leaving.
There is nobody left. It was a fine {place}.
An empty stage. I was the only one who watched.
So. Just us. Good. The rest was noise.

situation: The Protagonist is transforming and he waits (impatient)
line: Finish. I did not wait for this.
Take your moment. You will need it.
Glowing. It is a start.
Change and be done. Filth.
Continue. I will wait for the paperwork. As a courtesy to the dead.
A new hat. Fifth. Behind the goons.
Molt, if you must. Hurry.
Take your time, machine. Digest.
Restructuring. Even your body wants to leave you.
You dress second. You always did.
Poise.
Regalia. Now you will know who was watching.
Second rank. I permit it.
You were unaware of what I was. You will be aware.
Sovereign. Bow, or do not. The result is the same.
This is what I hold back. It was never kindness.
Apex. Do not look away.

situation: His Pride crashes and a form is lost
line: A pity. I liked the last one.

situation: A form is lost, regalia flakes off
line: It is coming apart. Do not stare.
Not now. ...Not now.
The Barrage.
Barrage.
Look. The Barrage.
The Verdict.
You were adequate. This is the verdict.
Fourth. Behind the goons. Sit down.
The court has ruled. It ruled ages ago.

situation: Finisher lands (disgusted, vs Empress or Cyborg)
line: Filth. Be quiet.
You were noise. Now there is none.
This is the last thing you will not deserve.
You are still here. That is not a compliment.
Stay down. Filth.
This does not count.
I did not fall. I chose the floor.

situation: He plants his feet and opens his arms (move name)
line: Chin Up.
Was that supposed to hurt?
Again. I was looking elsewhere.
That was your best? Noted.
Three. Is that all?
You may stop whenever you are ready.
I have arrived. Try to notice.

situation: Staredown before the first blow (vs Protagonist)
line: You are late. You were always late to be first.
You were something once. Let me see what is left.
You were a spectacle before you were a threat. Begin.
You were a machine that ate. You will be a machine that stopped.
Begin.
You were the second best man I knew.

situation: His free last signature is ready at the brink
line: I am not finished.

situation: His free last signature is ready, alternate
line: Not yet. Not for you.
You were adequate. That is the highest thing I say.
Fourth. Behind the furniture. You leave the ranks as you entered them.
It ends when I say. It has ended.
You fought well. For someone who was never going to win.
Remember this. You will not be asked again.
You were the only one worth the trouble.
I won. I won. I think I won.
You were loud. That was all you were.
This does not count.
You were lucky. I will not be lucky in your favour twice.
I do not accept this.
...Enough. Leave.
Do not tell anyone. I will know if you do.
Next time.

situation: He loses to the Protagonist, cracked
line: Don't look at me like that.
I can't rank you. I don't know how.
